$comment: What Mark is up to right now (nownownow.com style). Rendered by the `now` command and the SSR content. Update `updated` whenever the list changes. Never add anything here that reads as job-seeking: this site must not suggest Mark is open to roles.
items: Running Onshape's Product Operations & Strategy team at PTC through FY27 planning and the Schneider Electric acquisition announced in October 2026.
Rolling out AI developer tooling across Onshape R&D: agentic-harness guidelines, MCP servers over the data warehouse, and the governance to go with them.

Building an 'AI context dictionary' — a structured, agent-readable memory of my systems, preferences and a daily diary — so the agents that run my homelab, grocery orders and security sweeps start with real context.
RigReady 2.0: rebuilt from a requirements ledger with parallel Claude Code agents; working toward a first public release.
Hardening the homelab: Dependency-Track fed by nightly SBOM scans, a weekly security sweep, pinned image digests.
Outside: solo backpacking on the Appalachian Trail sections near home, and a 1991 Honda Acty kei truck that always needs something.
